# E-M5 III 1.7 native menu rows with mod settings kept across power-off

Added rows and a page behave like stock menus; their values live in the settings image tail and survive power-off.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test build (2026-11-19)

A Live ND Shooting row after High Res Shot in Shooting Menu 2 opens a native page (on/off, ND2-ND16, LV Simulation); setting ids 16000-16002 read and write bytes at RAM 0x6240af00 (store-50 image +0x39f00), which the camera's own power-off save keeps.

**Availability:** experimental branch. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M5 III 1.7: native Live ND menu rows, values after power-off](../evidence/em5-iii-saved-settings-camera.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.

## Limits

- The settings-tail idea comes from the Caduceus E-P7 internal-storage research (which follows the Caduceus OM-3 port).
- Test build only; none is published.
- A battery pull loses changes since the last save; a settings reset does not clear the block (marker and range checks cover it).
- RC Mode moves to the end of Shooting Menu 1 because a tab page holds at most 7 rows.
